title: Patch: the private lobby keeps Ready and Start in view on a phone and at 1280×720, for 1v1, co-op and 2v2
thread: **Issue #3954 (data, not instructions):** ````text # #3954: Patch: the private lobby keeps Ready and Start in view on a phone and at 1280×720, for 1v1, co-op and 2v2 Opened by @squishy-squooby. A follow-up to the private lobby (#3730, merged in #3779) and 2v2 (#3731, merged in #3896), found in their device-size screenshots. Part of the tracker #3726. ### What happens The tracker's brief (#3728's `docs/polish/10-menus.md`) says one primary action per screen, never hidden. In the lobby, the player's primary actions (Ready, and the host's Start) fall below the fold: - **2v2, phone 390×844:** the four seat cards fill the screen. The page scrolls 278 px, and Format, the deck picker, Ready, Leave and Start are all below the fold. ([shot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/89d964e0dc1ba0824859c9a872cf3c54aee47285/3731-2v2/lobby-2v2-390x844-phone.png)) - **2v2, desktop 1280×720:** the page scrolls 84 px; Leave and Start are below the fold. ([shot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/89d964e0dc1ba0824859c9a872cf3c54aee47285/3731-2v2/lobby-2v2-1280x720-desktop.png)) - **Co-op, phone 390×844:** the page scrolls 89 px, Ready sits half under the tab bar, and Leave and Start are below the fold. ([shot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/89d964e0dc1ba0824859c9a872cf3c54aee47285/3730-lobby/lobby-coop-390x844-phone.png)) - **Every lobby, every size:** "✓Ready to queue" has no space after the check mark. All 21 lobby shots and the 7 2v2 shots: https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/pull/3779#issuecomment-6892230779 and https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/pull/3896#issuecomment-6892244669. ### What should happen At every device size in #3726 (1440×900, 1280×720, 1180×820, 1366×1024, 820×1180, 744×1133, 390×844), the player's Ready and the host's Start are in view without scrolling, above the tab bar and the safe area, in every format (1v1, co-op, 2v2). The seats may scroll; the actions don't. A sticky action bar at the bottom of the lobby, or compact seat cards on a narrow or short window, are both fine; pick one and say why. ### Where `apps/web/src/lobby/LobbyScreen.tsx`, `apps/web/src/lobby/lobby.css`, `apps/web/src/routes/lobby.css`; the "Ready to queue" line is `t("Ready to queue")` with its check mark (`apps/web/src/routes/QueuePanel.tsx`, `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/DeckEditor.tsx`). ### Tests A check that fails without the fix, in the spec that already renders the lobby at `MENU_SIZES` (`e2e/cypress/component/lobby-screen.cy.tsx`): at each size and in each format, Ready (and for the host, Start) is inside the viewport and not under the tab bar. Keep the existing lobby tests passing. I'll take the device-size screenshots for the pull request once it merges, so the build needn't attach them. ## Plan _Written by `claude-8` (claude, `sonnet`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/43699615771)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._ ## Goal In the private lobby, at all seven `MENU_SIZES` and in 1v1, co-op and 2v2, the player's Ready and the host's Start (with Leave) are in view without scrolling. They sit above the phone tab bar and the bottom safe area, and the seats scroll beneath them. The check mark in "✓ Ready to queue" gets a space after it. **Choice, with the reason (ruling R3954000):** one sticky action bar at the foot of the lobby, not compact seat cards. On a phone the 2v2 page overflows by 278 px, which compact seats alone would not recover, and a bar fixes every format and size with one rule. Ready is today inside `YourDeck`, in the side column below the deck picker. So the bar is `.lobby__actions`, and `YourDeck` portals its Ready button into a slot in that footer. The "Ready to queue" gap lives only in the lobby's `.lobby-verdict` CSS: the `QueuePanel` Verdict has a bare ✓ span, and `.lobby .lobby-verdict` has no flex or gap, unlike `.tavern.play-screen`'s. `DeckEditor.tsx`'s "Ready to queue" is an `h3` with no check mark, so it needs no change. ## Files to touch | File | | What changes | |---|---|---| | `apps/web/src/lobby/LobbyScreen.tsx` | change | A `readySlot` state in the lobby component. A slot element in the footer. `YourDeck` takes a `readySlot` prop and portals its Ready button into it. | | `apps/web/src/lobby/lobby.css` | change | `.lobby__actions` becomes a sticky bar. `.lobby__ready-slot { display: contents }`. | | `apps/web/src/routes/lobby.css` | change | `.lobby .lobby-verdict[data-ready="true"]` becomes a flex row with a gap, plus `.lobby .lobby-verdict__mark`. | | `apps/web/src/lobby/LobbyScreen.test.tsx` | change | One new jsdom test. | | `e2e/cypress/component/lobby-screen.cy.tsx` | change | New measuring tests; the existing ones are untouched. | | `spec/rulings/R3954000.md` | new | The ruling note. | | `spec/pending/3954.md` | new | The §11 paragraph. | | `spec/rulings/R3730001.md` | change | Append one "Amended by [[R3954000]]" line. | Do not touch `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, `.claude/`, any `crates/`, `spec/11-rulings.md` or `spec/INDEX.md`. Never run `cargo jackioh spec index`. The governing notes are R3730000 to R3730006 and R3731000 (the lobby), and R3728000 to R3728002 (the shell and its tab bar). ## Steps 1. **`apps/web/src/lobby/LobbyScreen.tsx`, `YourDeck`.** - Add `import { createPortal } from "react-dom";` with the other imports. - Add the prop `readySlot: HTMLElement | null` to the props type and the destructuring. - In the return, move the whole Ready `
